name: Grand Ocean Retail Group Ltd.
summary: Grand Ocean Retail Group Ltd. primarily operates within China's department store retail sector, additionally providing management consulting services. The company manages a network of 17 retail establishments spread across 12 different cities, including major hubs such as Nanjing, Wuhan, Chongqing, Fuzhou, Suzhou, Quanzhou, Xiantan, Hengyang, Yichang, and Hefei. Founded in 2002, its corporate headquarters are located in Taipei, Taiwan.
